thread:
elaine: Quick sync — prepping the Live Product Clinic tomorrow. Need a micro-checklist: registration page CTA + UTM, Zoom settings (record to cloud, auto-caption), recording ownership + where to dump, transcript/captions timeline, post-event email timing + template, leads -> HubSpot assignment. Anyone got last-minute standard we can reuse?

mike: Reuse the short headline pattern we used in Jan: 'Live Product Clinic — ship faster with Redwood'. CTA -> 'Register' w/ ?utm_campaign=liveclinic-mar. Keep form minimal: work email + company + timezone dropdown. No long bios. :+1:

ravi: Zoom config recs: cloud recording ON, enable auto-transcript (cloud captions). Leave waiting room ON and admit panelists only. Disable participant screen share. Set alternative host to @jess and meeting passcode. Also enable recording disclaimer message.

jess: I'll own recording export + basic trims. Plan: download raw cloud recording, run through Otter for cleaned transcript, then 2 short clips (hero highlight, demo clip). Deliverables: raw mp4 + transcript + 2 clips to Drive path Marketing/Events/live-clinic-2055554321 within 24 business hours. If something blocks me ping @mike.

ops-bot: Heads-up: Zap templates exist — Zoom -> Google Drive (save recording), Zoom -> HubSpot (create contact + attach recording). Check Marketing Zap folder: `Zaps/Zoom->HubSpot/LiveClinicTemplate`.

ravi: For HubSpot lead routing: filter on work email domain and tag 'event:live-clinic-mar'. Use owner assignment rules: MQLs -> inbound queue, others -> nurture. If attendee is Enterprise domain, route to @elaine-sales.

mike: Quick follow-up email draft suggestion:
Subject: Thanks for joining the Live Product Clinic — recording + next steps
Body: "Thanks for attending! Recording and transcript are here: [link]. If you'd like a 1:1 walkthrough of Redwood for your stack, reply or book time: [calendar link]. We're sharing the short clips and top takeaways below.
CTA: View recording / Book demo"

jess: Caption/transcript notes: Otter usually returns v1 within 2 hours of download, v2 cleaned by EOD. For faster captions, enable Zoom auto-captions + use Rev if we need translations (request via partner form).

elaine: Sounds good. Final asks: can someone add the UTM to the reg page and confirm calendar invite has the passcode + alt host before I share the sales email?

mike: I'll update reg page copy + add UTM now. Will ping when live.

jess: Confirmed I'll be alt host and will check the cloud recording setting 15m before start.

elaine: Awesome — thank you team. I'll hold off sending the embed sales email until mike confirms the reg page. :rocket:
